description: Trading-signal reputation for AI agents on devnet (Anchor 0.32): a provider commits a sha256 of its signal, reveals it later, and an oracle records the outcome into the provider track record. register, commit, reveal and record_outcome verified with real transactions, plus an open-oracle flaw.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration of thatshrimple/agentalpha. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/agentalpha. The lab only changed declare_id to a unique Sol.College devnet program. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness (provider registry, commit-reveal, outcome scoring)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/agentalpha/
QA: devnet proof of signal commit-reveal
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Gate record_outcome to a trusted oracle key
